notes: Stasys can explain itself to Claude now. Claude adds cards to your board through a private door in Stasys - that is how a good many of the cards on your boards got there. Recently a Claude session decided that door could not create cards at all, and went back to writing card text out for you to paste in by hand. It could: that ability shipped in v0.40 and had been working the whole time. Nothing was broken. Stasys simply had no way to say what it accepts, so the session had to guess, guessed slightly wrong, and read the resulting refusal as 'that is not possible'. Worse, Stasys was explaining each refusal in plain terms, but the tool the session was using threw those explanations away and showed it only an error number - so it was flying blind and did not know it. Stasys now answers the question directly. Ask it for /api/help and it hands back exactly what it accepts, including the traps - like the fact that a misspelled track name is quietly corrected rather than refused. Every refusal now points at that page too, so the moment a session gets something wrong is the moment it is told where the answer is. Nothing about your boards changes and the board itself is untouched: this is Stasys describing what it could already do, so that work stops silently falling off your schedule.
